I think about this year the same way I did last year. My body is old, just me and my wife at home, so I cannot do too much hard work. I keep 4 mu for wheat-maize, and 1 mu for cotton on the corner plot near the road.

For wheat, I sow in October like always. I buy improved seed from the dealer in town — the one my neighbor Old Wang uses, his wheat was good last year. I put down about 2 bags of compound fertilizer (one bag 50 jin) per mu before ploughing, and then one bag of urea at jointing when the wheat stands up. That comes to maybe 18 kg nitrogen per mu. Too little and the wheat looks yellow, then I lose my harvest — I would rather spend the extra 20 yuan on fertilizer. I water 3 times from my well: before winter, at jointing, and at filling. Spray once for aphids in spring, maybe once more if I see rust. I hope for 450 kg per mu, that is what Old Wang usually gets.

For maize after wheat, I sow directly after harvest, no ploughing, just rotary. Hybrid seed, the one the village shop recommended — everybody plants it. I put down 2 bags of compound fertilizer at sowing and one bag of urea when the plant is knee-high. About 16 kg nitrogen per mu. Water once or twice if the rain is late. Spray once for borer. I expect around 500 kg per mu.

For cotton on the 1 mu, I use improved seed. Cotton eats less nitrogen than maize but needs more pesticide — bollworm is a devil. I put down one and a half bags compound at planting, top-dress urea at flowering. Spray many times, maybe 6-7 times through the summer, this is how cotton is. Water 2 times. I hope for 220 kg seed cotton per mu. Cotton gives cash, that is why I still grow it even though it tires me.
